name: revision-ordered-publication
explain: Enforce causal event ordering, monotonic revision horizons, and rejection of stale out-of-order publications caused by network jitter. Proves why network arrival order fails as a source of truth and enforces event-time watermark invariants.
steps: Ingest advancing event revisions into authoritative state records. || Intercept delayed out-of-order revisions, asserting that the server rejects stale updates to prevent state corruption.
expect: Revision ordered publication verified: current_revision=3, rejected_stale=2, accepted=2

name: decoupled-execution-lifetimes
explain: Decouple ephemeral transport connections, conversational sessions, and durable background tasks into independent lifecycles. Ensures that connection drops do not abort running background tasks, allowing reconnected clients to retrieve completed results.
steps: Dispatch a long-running research task on an active session and simulate sudden transport connection termination. || Progress task to completion in background and reconnect client on a new connection, successfully retrieving task results.
expect: Decoupled execution lifetimes verified: original_connection=disconnected, task_status=completed, reconnected_result_delivered=True

name: work-reduction-coalescing
explain: Implement work reduction strategies for high-frequency input streams by debouncing rapid user keystrokes and coalescing intermediate entity state updates, while strictly preserving discrete non-conflatable business commands.
steps: Debounce rapid typing keystrokes until a declared silence window elapses with no new input. || Coalesce intermediate document state updates so only the latest revision executes, while retaining all discrete commands.
expect: Work reduction coalescing verified: debounced_query=apple, coalesced_revision=3, preserved_commands=2, dropped_intermediate=2

name: fault-recovery-resilience-suite
explain: Verify live agent resilience across four mandatory failure modes: client reconnection, mid-stream barge-in cancellation, overload backpressure shedding, and pod crash recovery from durable checkpoints.
steps: Execute automated checks verifying session re-attachment, mid-stream barge-in interruption, and overload backpressure shedding. || Assert that pod crash failover successfully recovers uncommitted state from durable checkpoints.
expect: Fault recovery resilience suite verified: all_passed=True, scenarios_tested=['correction', 'overload', 'reconnection', 'restart'], shed_overload_count=1

name: live-telemetry-freshness-monitor
explain: Distinguish transport-level connection liveness from application-level semantic freshness. Monitors served revision lag and queue age to detect silent pipeline stall conditions even when transport heartbeats are green.
steps: Evaluate telemetry signals from healthy sessions, verifying zero revision lag and low queue latency. || Evaluate pathological sessions where heartbeats remain green but revision lag and queue age flag a silent stall.
expect: Live telemetry freshness verified: healthy_lag=0, stalled_lag=3, stalled_queue_age=40.0, silent_stall_detected=True

name: perception-invalidation-guard
explain: Enforce pre-dispatch precondition verification and perception invalidation for live assistants. Rejects planned tool actions whose observational prerequisites have become obsolete due to concurrent environment mutations.
steps: Record perceptual observation and construct an action proposal targeting visual coordinates at revision 1. || Mutate live environment to revision 2, asserting that the pre-dispatch gate rejects the stale action and triggers re-observation.
expect: Perception invalidation guard verified: stale_action_rejected=True, freshened_action_executed=True, final_revision=2
